div.div: 6 تنابزوا , (Msb, K, *) or تنابزوا بِٱلْأَلْقَابِ, (S,) They called one another by by-names, surnames, or [rather] nicknames: (S, Msb, * K:) or they upbraided, reproached, or reviled, one another; (K, TA;) calling one another by names of reproach. (TA.) So in the Kur, xlix. 11; where the doing so is forbidden. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
